title: Mahlanya Clan Economy
description: Schema for FClanEconomicState and the cattle flow graph. Community modders can edit data files conforming to this schema to alter clan economics, tribute relationships, and trade routes without touching C++ source code.

clans.description: All clans whose economic state is simulated. Each entry maps to one FClanEconomicState instance.

cattle_flows.description: Directed edges of the cattle flow graph. Each edge represents a monthly transfer of cattle between two clans.

clan.title: Clan Economic State
clan.description: Economic snapshot of a single Swazi clan. Values are sampled every in-game month by the FClanEconomicState tick.

id.description: Unique clan identifier used as foreign key in cattle_flows and protocol data.

cattle_count.description: Current head of cattle owned by the clan. Wealth and political standing in Swazi society are cattle-denominated.

political_strength.description: Normalised political influence of the clan within the Swazi kingdom (0 = powerless, 1 = royal family authority).

colonial_pressure.description: Degree of direct colonial economic pressure the clan is experiencing (0 = none, 1 = land fully alienated / concessions dominate).

drought_stress.description: Current grazing/crop stress from drought conditions (0 = lush season, 1 = severe drought threatening herd viability).

concessions.description: List of concession IDs granted to colonial companies or settlers that reduce the clan's effective land area.

cattle_flow.title: Cattle Flow Edge
cattle_flow.description: A directed monthly cattle transfer between two clans. Constitutes an edge in the cattle flow graph used by the economic simulation.

from.description: ID of the source clan (the clan transferring cattle).

to.description: ID of the destination clan (the clan receiving cattle).

cattle_per_month.description: Number of cattle transferred from 'from' to 'to' each in-game month under normal conditions. The simulation may apply drought_stress and colonial_pressure modifiers at runtime.

flow_type.description: The social/economic mechanism driving this cattle transfer. Determines which gameplay systems are notified on transfer.
